deviations.description: scripts/lint/lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh — remove the four -hard SKILL.md entries from its path list
deviations.reason: EXCLUDED_FILES is a file-level exemption allowlist, not a mere inventory. Each -hard SKILL.md still contains one genuine hand-rolled task-lookup shape that is only accepted today via the whole-file allowlist entry. Removing the entry while the file still exists (true until Phase 4 deletes it) surfaces 4 new violations, which is worse than the Phase 1 baseline (0). Deleting the file and removing its exemption entry must land in the same commit -- exactly the same atomicity reasoning Phase 4 already states for its own deletion+manifest-surgery commit.
